predecessors.name: Daxi culture
predecessors.text: "centered in the Three Gorges region around the middle Yangtze", "western Hubei"

successors.name: Shijiahe Culture
successors.text: the Qujialing country with the former Daxi lands of the Three Gorges

ledger.x: 3400 BCE: the Qujialing culture appears on the Jianghan Plain and the middle Yangtze of Hubei and Hunan ("The Qujialing culture (3400-2500 BC)"); its earliest evidence "may belong to the final phase of the Daxi culture".
3300 BCE: the Qujialing takes the Three Gorges of western Hubei from the Daxi ("The Qujialing culture... succeeded the Daxi culture (5000-3300 BC)").
2500 BCE: the Qujialing ends ("3400-2500 BC") and the Shijiahe culture follows on the middle Yangtze.

certainty.note: No border is recorded; large fortified settlements (up to 263 ha) are the only fixed points.
